serverNotReady.where: Library (archive, rename, upload): Error toast/message when the server's database connection is not initialised (rare, transient).

fileNotFound.where: Library: error when archiving/restoring or renaming a chart that no longer exists
fileNotFound.context: 'File' = the chart (sheet-music file) in the library

crossTenantChordCacheWrite.where: Chart viewer: error when saving detected chords/key for a chart that belongs to another congregation's library (normally never seen)
crossTenantChordCacheWrite.context: Lower-case is intentional (technical message). 'chord-cache' = saved chord positions/key detected on a chart.

missingFileId.where: Chart viewer: error when a chord-cache request named no chart
missingFileId.context: 'fileId' is a technical field name; may stay as-is

chordsVerifiedNeedsMusician.where: Chart viewer: error when someone who is not signed in as a musician tries to mark a chart's chords as verified
chordsVerifiedNeedsMusician.context: 'chordsVerified' is a technical field name ('chords verified' flag); may stay as-is

displayNameEmpty.where: Library: error when renaming a chart to a blank title
displayNameEmpty.context: 'displayName' is the chart title field; translators may say 'The title cannot be empty.'

fileIdsRequired.where: Library page: error when the song-usage badge request named no charts (developer error, rarely shown)

tooManyFileIds.where: Library page: error when the song-usage badge request asked about too many charts at once (developer error, rarely shown)

uploadPermissionRequired.where: Library upload dialog: error when the user is not allowed to upload charts

noFileProvided.where: Library upload dialog: error when the upload contained no file

uploaded.where: Library upload dialog: success message after a chart was uploaded
uploaded.context: {title} is the chart's title, shown in quotes
